provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: antecedent witness is the Mame, Tours 1922 (editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam); 83% of the 1962 body's tokens align in order after canon folding; the witness text layer damages 'Ecclésiz tuze' where the 1962 prints 'Ecclesiae tuae'; the witness text layer damages 'perpétuusintercéssor Per Dominum Et' where the 1962 prints 'perpetuus intercessor'; the Mame prints j where the 1962 prints i (Iesum/Jesum, eius/ejus) and its recogniser renders the ae ligature as 'z' or 'e'; both are orthographic; pointing: the antecedent's reading is recorded verbatim above so its commas and colons can be compared, but its punctuation is NOT safely collatable - the recogniser turns commas into full stops, semicolons and question marks - so no punctuation difference here should be read as a difference between the printings; the 1962 prints the conclusion as 'Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.'; conclusion length was excluded from the alignment and is recorded here as printed, per the settled rule. Corroboration: Pustet 1862 text-layer lines 53388-53394 (65% coverage); Benziger 1962 conformed printing at line 107900 (70%; comparison only, never a publication basis). Recorded limitation: The antecedent reading is taken from that witness's text layer, not from a page image, so its letterforms are inferred rather than read; only the 1962 target was read on a page. I did not collate the antecedent's Introit, readings, chants or any Secunda Oratio / Alia Secreta / Alia Postcommunio.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Majestatem tuam, Domine, suppliciter exoramus: ut, sicut Ecclesiae tuae
beatus Andreas Apostolus exstitit praedicator et rector; ita apud te sit pro
nobis perpetuus intercessor. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium
tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Sacrificium nostrum tibi, Domine, quaesumus, beati Andreae Apostoli precatio
sancta conciliet: ut, in cujus honore solemniter exhibetur, ejus meritis
efficiatur acceptum. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui
tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Sumpsimus, Domine, divina mysteria, beati Andreae festivitate laetantes:
quae, sicut tuis Sanctis ad gloriam, ita nobis, quaesumus, ad veniam
prodesse perficias. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui
tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.
